info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Strategy Development API
info.description: The Corporate Strategy Development API enables businesses to formulate and maintain their strategic direction. This API allows users to submit, update, and manage corporate strategy proposals, ensuring alignment with overarching business goals. Typical consumers of this API include business analysts, strategy teams, and corporate decision-makers looking to implement effective strategic initiatives. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their strategic planning processes and improve decision-making outcomes.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to define and create a new corporate strategy, outlining the direction and goals for the business. Users can provide necessary details in the request body to establish a strategic framework.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a corporate strategy operation. It should include all necessary details for the business direction being proposed.
